data.title: Ladder Capital Corp Announces Third Quarter 2026 Dividend to Holders of Class A Common Stock
data.description: In New York, Ladder Capital Corp (NYSE: LADR) revealed a third quarter 2026 dividend of $0.23 per Class A common stock. The dividend will be paid on October 15, 2026, to shareholders holding stock as of September 30, 2026. Ladder is an internally-managed, investment grade REIT with a primary focus on originating first mortgages.

data.title: Capstone Energy+ Delivers Additional 2 MW for Major U.S. Natural Gas Infrastructure Project
data.description: In Los Angeles, Capstone Energy+, Inc. (NASDAQ: CEPL) revealed they have provided two more C1000S Signature Series gas turbines for an ongoing U.S. midstream natural gas infrastructure project in southern New Mexico. Capstone, a key player in clean gas turbine energy solutions for industrial and commercial sectors, as well as emerging data center applications, is supporting the project's expansion. The delivery of the turbines aims to bolster the infrastructure project's operations.

data.title: Hyperfine Announces Completion of Enrollment in the Contrast PMR Study to Support the Submission to Expand Indications for Use of the Swoop® System with Contrast Agents
data.description: A study conducted in Guilford, Connecticut has successfully enrolled participants to support the expected expansion of indications for using the Swoop® system with contrast agents. The completion of enrollment marks a significant milestone in the research, with important numbers of participants involved in the study for obtaining valuable insights.

data.title: Oomph and Adapt USA Combine Forces to Become Pare & Co
data.description: A company based in Boston, Oomph, has introduced a new brand called Pare & Co, marking its acquisition of Adapt USA. Pare & Co is the result of a strategic move by Oomph to expand its presence in the AI sector. The acquisition of Adapt USA signifies a significant step towards enhancing their investment in AI technology. This development highlights Oomph’s commitment to growth and innovation as they continue to expand their portfolio.

data.title: Unlikely pairs like David Sacks, Lina Khan, Bernie Sanders, Steve Bannon join forces in the AI regulation debate.
data.description: Unexpected partnerships are forming in the ongoing discussion about limitations on artificial intelligence. Individuals such as David Sacks, Lina Khan, Bernie Sanders, and Steve Bannon are engaging in this debate. This diverse group of figures reflects the broad range of perspectives on the topic. The issue is gaining traction as prominent voices join the conversation, with the potential for significant impact on the future development of AI.

data.title: Capital Automotive Reacquires Full Ownership of MTI Automotive Retail Net Lease Portfolio
data.description: Capital Automotive L.P., a company owned by Ares Alternative Credit and Real Estate Funds, has successfully acquired a 90.01% stake from its joint venture partner in the MTI Portfolio. This portfolio comprises 49 assets of automotive retail real estate. The recent transaction marks the restoration of Capital Automotive's complete ownership of the MTI Portfolio, which it had partially sold in 2020. Ares took over ownership of Capital Automotive in 2022.
